item.text: {"issues":[{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Users report downloads disappearing or needing to be repeated, incomplete or unavailable downloads, offline lists not loading, a device limit despite reported use on one device, and unwanted automatic downloads.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["590359ee-0d43-4c2e-aacc-48ae9fe9ec99","add2cb57-2f34-4c5e-8e37-19357f05e6b4"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_03","issue_name":"Download reliability and controls"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Users report that searching for songs returns no results or says songs are unavailable; one example expresses only general enthusiasm.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["3dbce345-5c68-45c4-82fb-688ce8b28029"],"issue_id":"TMP_CATALOG_01","issue_name":"Song search results and availability"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Users object to unwanted recommendations being added to playlists or played during listening; other examples focus on limited catalog breadth, repetitive recommendations, or ads.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["76ecabc5-5a8b-41ab-a93a-4cdf334c4616","644598d4-fb2e-4600-8f37-f70241164fe8"],"issue_id":"TMP_CATALOG_02","issue_name":"Unwanted recommended songs"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Most users report songs disappearing or being removed, while other examples mention regional restrictions or cataloging problems.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["8cd76cd9-81b5-4e2e-b68f-2c45c800e176","ec116cd6-00c0-485a-961a-ffebc01661ca"],"issue_id":"TMP_CATALOG_03","issue_name":"Songs removed from catalog"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Users cite songs they cannot find or select, while other examples mention ads, recommendations, or broad praise of the available catalog.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["b99e001c-5564-4e20-a2e3-a7a5da5ff45e","4be31ae3-d543-423b-a494-1fdd19cdb34e","480e7d35-c0c0-4546-bc80-f2c5864eaf1b"],"issue_id":"TMP_CATALOG_04","issue_name":"Missing songs in catalog"}]}
